text:
anya: Quick design sync — proposing we split "smoke" vs "prober" responsibilities more clearly. Smoke = quick gate (deterministic checks). Prober = orchestrated fuzz + provenance artifacts. Goal: fewer false accepts, better triage info.

lucca: +1. Can you outline the minimal artifact prober should emit? I care about reproducibility and easy triage.

anya: Minimal artifact set: `manifest.json` (model_digest, tokenizer_digest, handshake_schema, bench_suite_version, seed), `metrics.json` (p50/p95, cost_est, quality_scores), `samples/` (input->output pairs for failing cases), and `signature.sig` (signed manifest). Store under s3://onboard-artifacts/<model-id>/runs/<run-id> with retention.

sam: Signature is key — prevents later tampering. Ops will want to verify these during audits. What signing key do we use?

ops-bot: INFO: we use the onboarding service KMS key `projects/redwood/keys/onboard-ingest` for artifact signing. Verify with `ops verify-signature`.

lucca: For the prober run, I propose a hybrid sample set: canonical deterministic core (N=50), seeded fuzz per bucket (seeded RNG with run-id), and adversarial mirrors (known failure cases). That gives reproducible root cause + edge discovery.

anya: Agreed. Prober orchestration should record `random_seed`, `bench_config_hash`, and `runner_image` in manifest so we can fully replay. Also include the exact commit SHA of bench-suite.

sam: On failure codes: let's standardize a small taxonomy so downstream UIs can filter: VOCAB_MISMATCH, TOKENIZATION_DRIFT, KV_SHAPE_MISMATCH, LATENCY_P95_EXCEEDED, QUALITY_REGRESSION, RESOURCE_OOM. Each code maps to remediation suggestions.

lucca: UX idea: intake returns compact `decision` + `artifact_link` even on smoke pass. That way product can fetch full prober details later. Example: `{decision: "smoke:pass,prober:queued", artifact: "s3://.../runs/123/manifest.json"}`.

anya: Also make smoke idempotent and read-only. It should not register model until prober completes a non-failing run or an operator acknowledges a warn. Smoke only writes a provisional entry with `status:ingested_provisional` that requires `prober:complete` or `override:true`.

bench-bot: AUTO: scheduled prober run for model 'orca-lite' (mid: m-892) run-id=run-20260321-001. ETA ~70m. Artifact path: s3://onboard-artifacts/m-892/runs/run-20260321-001/.

lucca: For tokenization drift metric: compute exact token-id diffs for the canonical core and report `token_match_rate` and `first_last_token_mismatch_count`. If match_rate < threshold -> fail. Keeps it explainable.

sam: Quantization gotchas: some quant profiles change output ordering for tail tokens. We must include `decode_checks` that compare trimmed tail outputs against golden trim. Simple heuristic: compare last 12 tokens for equality or similarity.

anya: Good point. Add `tail_consistency_score` to metrics.json. If below 0.7 -> flag `QUALITY_REGRESSION`.

ops-bot: POLICY: onboarding artifacts default retention = 90d. Long-term audits need `retain=true` flag which operators can set per-model.

lucca: Implementation notes: prober should run in a sandboxed job with resource caps; retries use exponential backoff 30s->2m->8m up to 3 attempts. If OOM occurs repeatedly, mark `RESOURCE_OOM` and attach runner logs.

anya: CLI snippet for local dev:```bash
redwood-ingest --model-dir ./out --run-smoke --output-artifact ./out/smoke-artifact
# emits smoke-manifest.json with minimal fields and exits 0/1
```

sam: And orchestration API example response:```json
{"ingest_id":"m-892","status":{"smoke":"pass","prober":"queued"},"artifact":"s3://onboard-artifacts/m-892/runs/run-20260321-001/manifest.json"}
```

lucca: One more: make sure bench-suite emits a compact `explainability` field for each failing sample: tokenized diff, logits-checksum, example input. That speeds root-cause.

anya: Next steps: I will draft an artifact schema PR (manifest v1) and a small runner shim that signs manifests. Lucca, can you own prober sampling harness? Sam, can you add remediation text for each failure code? Target EOD Thu for PRs.

lucca: Yup, will start on harness.

sam: Will draft remediation doc.

anya: Perfect. If bench-bot posts a fail, open a per-model thread and include artifact link. We'll triage there. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: NOTE: prober started (run-20260321-001). Posting metrics+artifact when complete.
